Prep time: 15 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 15 minutes Number of Servings: 6 Ingredients 1 cup peas, fresh, frozen or canned 6 cups salad greens, torn in bite size pieces 1/2 cup chopped cucumber 1/2 cup low-fat salad dressing 1/2 cup low-fat feta cheese Directions Thaw and drain frozen peas or rinse and drain canned peas. In a large serving bowl, combine peas, salad greens and cucumber. Add dressing just before serving. Toss to mix well. Sprinkle with feta cheese. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Try adding 2 tablespoons of chopped fresh mint to this salad for a refreshing twist!
